notes: Phase 2-N sbom-scan benchmark. The SBOM describes alpine 3.10
(EOL since 2021-05). Grype's current advisory DB surfaces a
large CVE set against it — 100+ findings is normal. We pin a
small set of well-known CRITICAL CVEs as the recall target;
the full count drifts as the Grype DB rolls forward but the
anchor CVEs below are stable because the vulnerable apk/openssl/
zlib package versions are fixed in the SBOM file itself.

expected_vulnerabilities.note: libfetch in alpine 3.10 fails Content-Length validation on HTTP redirects → buffer overflow. Same finding as Phase 2-M image bench — cross-engine validation: secscan image (Trivy) and secscan sbom (Grype) should both detect this on the same target.
SM2 decryption buffer overflow in alpine 3.10's openssl 1.1.1k.
heap-based buffer over-read in inflate.c via a large gzip header extra field.
